description: This Java class 'EventScheduler' manages scheduling of 'SchedulableEvent' objects in a timestamped buffer, supporting thread-safe addition, removal, and waiting for events based on system nanotime. It includes internal classes for event queues and events, with methods for event pooling, adding, retrieving, and waiting for events.

classes.name: EventScheduler
classes.description: Manages scheduling and retrieval of timestamped events with thread safety.

classes.name: SchedulableEvent
classes.description: Base class for events that can be scheduled, containing timestamp and linkage for queueing.

methods.name: removeEventfromPool
methods.description: Retrieves an event from the pool if available, leaving at least one event in the pool.

methods.name: addEventToPool
methods.description: Returns an event to the pool for reuse, with a maximum pool size limit.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an event to the scheduler, maintaining order and notifying waiting threads if necessary.

methods.name: getNextEvent
methods.description: Returns the next event ready for processing based on current time.

methods.name: waitNextEvent
methods.description: Blocks until the next scheduled event is ready, based on system nanotime.
